I have built **Cyber Runner 3D**, a fast-paced sci-fi endless runner game built in WebGL with Three.js.

You can play the live game here:
👉 **[Play Cyber Runner 3D](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e59bc8bc-72b3-4d63-b290-801a225b4b51/f2b44e3bc512033f5ac68a89/)**

---

### 🎮 Gameplay & Features

1. **Procedural 3D World**:
   - Dynamic 3-lane neon synthwave highway surrounded by low-poly skyscrapers, neon light beams, glowing lane dividers, and a synthwave grid horizon.
   - Smooth continuous track chunk streaming and obstacle generation.

2. **Hero Controls & Mechanics**:
   - **Lane Switching**: Smooth spring-lerp transitions with realistic banking roll (`A` / `D` or `←` / `→` or swipe left/right).
   - **Jump & Double Jump**: Leap over laser hurdles and barriers (`W` / `↑` / `Space` or swipe up). Double jump for aerial control.
   - **Slide & Fast Dive**: Duck under high-voltage laser gates (`S` / `↓` or swipe down). Press down while airborne to dive down immediately.
   - **Launch Ramps**: Speed ramps that launch your hero high into the sky over blockades to collect floating coin arcs.
   - **Moving Drone Hazards**: Security drones that patrol side-to-side between lanes.

3. **Power-Ups**:
   - 🧲 **Coin Magnet**: Vacuums all nearby energy coins directly into your runner.
   - 🛡️ **Energy Shield**: Absorbs obstacle collisions with a crash deflection bubble and temporary invulnerability.
   - ✨ **Score Multiplier**: Doubles/triples score gain.
   - ⚡ **Hyper Jet Boost**: Supersonic rocket thruster blast that renders you invincible and smashes obstacles out of the way.

4. **Procedural Web Audio Engine**:
   - Driving synthwave electronic soundtrack with dynamic tempo scaling that accelerates as your run speed increases.
   - Procedural audio effects for jumps, slides, coin chime streaks, power-ups, and impacts (zero external audio dependencies).

5. **Shop, Customization & Upgrades**:
   - Unlockable cyber-suit chromas: *Cyber Striker*, *Crimson Valkyrie*, *Solar Vanguard*, *Emerald Ghost*, and *Void Phantom*.
   - Persistent upgrades for Magnet Duration, Shield Strength, Multiplier, and Hyper Jet Boost (stored in `localStorage`).

6. **Mobile & Desktop Support**:
   - Touch gestures (swipe left, right, up, down) and on-screen virtual touch controls for phones/tablets.
   - Keyboard controls (`WASD` / Arrow keys / Space / ESC) for desktop.

---

I have upgraded and polished **Cyber Runner 3D** with dynamic biomes, a near-miss dodge mechanic, floating score popups, and mission objectives!

Play the game now:
👉 **[Play Cyber Runner 3D](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e59bc8bc-72b3-4d63-b290-801a225b4b51/f2b44e3bc512033f5ac68a89/)**

---

### 🌟 New Features & Enhancements

1. **Dynamic Zone / Biome Transitions**:
   - **Zone 1: Neo Tokyo (0–450m)** — Deep neon cyan skyscrapers, atmospheric purple fog, and cyan speed lines.
   - **Zone 2: Outrun Sunset (450–950m)** — Warm retro sunset horizon, crimson fog, and amber hurdles.
   - **Zone 3: Matrix Void (950m+)** — Acid green and obsidian monoliths with high-speed digital pulse grids.
   - Features animated on-screen zone transition banners.

2. **Near-Miss Dodge System**:
   - Switching lanes within split-seconds of an incoming obstacle triggers a **`NEAR MISS! +250`** bonus with slow-mo feedback, particle sparks, and sound.

3. **Floating Arcade Popups**:
   - Real-time animated score and status popups for `DOUBLE JUMP! ⚡`, `RAMP FLIGHT! 🚀`, `SMASH! +150`, `STREAK x15! 🪙`, and `NEAR MISS! +250`.

4. **In-Run Missions & Bounties**:
   - Active missions to earn bonus coins during your run (e.g., reaching distance milestones, gathering coins, landing near-miss dodges).
   - Triumphant audio fanfare and gold toast notifications upon completion.

5. **Audio Preferences & State Persistence**:
   - Audio and SFX toggle states are remembered across sessions via `localStorage`.

I have built **IronPulse Gym Manager**, a full-featured gym and fitness club management application specifically designed to capture member mobile numbers and automatically dispatch renewal messages **3 days before membership expires**.

You can open and test the live application here:
👉 **[Open IronPulse Gym Management App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e59bc8bc-72b3-4d63-b290-801a225b4b51/f2b44e3bc512033f5ac68a89/)**

---

### 🌟 Key Features

1. **Member Registration with Mobile Numbers**:
   - Captures **Full Name**, **Mobile Number** *(required for SMS/WhatsApp notices)*, Email, Gender, Membership Plan (1, 3, 6, 12 Months), Start Date, Amount Paid, Payment Mode (Cash, UPI, Card), Emergency Contact, and Fitness Goals/Notes.
   - Automatically calculates the exact **Expiry Date** based on the chosen plan duration.

2. **Automated 3-Day Expiry Reminder Engine**:
   - **Background Scanner**: Automatically detects any member whose membership is expiring in **≤ 3 days** (e.g., 3 days left, 2 days left, 1 day left, or today).
   - **Automated Dispatch**: When enabled, the auto-bot queues and logs reminder notices without manual effort and marks them as dispatched for the day.
   - **Direct WhatsApp & SMS Integration**: 
     - **WhatsApp Direct**: 1-click launch to WhatsApp Web / App (`wa.me/<number>?text=...`) with pre-filled message.
     - **Native SMS**: Opens your device's SMS composer.
     - **Bulk Dispatch**: "Send All 3-Day Reminders" button sends alerts to all qualifying members at once.
   - **Customizable Message Template**: Fully customizable with dynamic tags (`{memberName}`, `{gymName}`, `{planName}`, `{daysLeft}`, `{expiryDate}`, `{gymPhone}`).

3. **Urgent Alert Dashboard**:
   - Real-time stat cards: *Total Members*, *Active Members*, ***Expiring in ≤ 3 Days***, *Expired*, *Monthly Revenue*, and *Reminders Sent*.
   - Prominent Amber Alert Banner displaying members due for reminders.
   - Quick filters: `All`, `⚠️ Expiring in 3 Days`, `Active`, `Expired`.

4. **Front-Desk Check-in & Attendance**:
   - Fast check-in by mobile number or name.
   - Instantly shows member status upon check-in and warns staff if their membership is expiring within 3 days.

5. **Quick Renewal & Digital Receipts**:
   - 1-click renewal extends validity (+1, +3, +6, or +12 months) and resets the reminder trigger.
   - Printable branded gym receipts with payment breakdown.

6. **Export & Backup**:
   - One-click **Export to CSV** containing all members, mobile numbers, expiry dates, and statuses.
   - Complete JSON database backup and restore.

### 🌐 Deploying to Your Own Domain or Platform

Because this app is built with static web technologies ([index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html), [css/style.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/style.css), and [js/app.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/app.js)), it requires zero build steps or database configuration and can be hosted anywhere for free.

#### Step 1: Connect to GitHub
Tap the **GitHub mark at the top of the chat** to connect your GitHub account. Your entire project history and files will be automatically transferred to your new repository.

#### Step 2: Choose a Free Hosting Provider

1. **GitHub Pages (Easiest)**:
   - Go to your repository on GitHub.
   - Click **Settings** > **Pages** (in the left sidebar).
   - Under **Build and deployment > Branch**, select `main` and `/ (root)`, then click **Save**.
   - Your site will be live at `https://<your-username>.github.io/<repo-name>/`.

2. **Vercel**:
   - Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) and log in with GitHub.
   - Click **Add New Project** and select your gym app repository.
   - Click **Deploy** (no build settings required).

3. **Netlify**:
   - Go to [netlify.com](https://netlify.com) and log in with GitHub.
   - Click **Add new site** > **Import an existing project**.
   - Select your repository and click **Deploy Site**.

4. **Self-Hosted / cPanel / Apache / Nginx**:
   - Simply copy the contents of this folder ([index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html), [css/style.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/style.css), and [js/app.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/app.js)) into your server's `public_html` or web root directory.
